about_content: This software provides, bundles, and proxies no music content or audio sources. It plays only local files and network storage content that users have legally obtained themselves. Users are responsible for the legality of what they play.
about_desc: A player for local and NAS music libraries. The interface, playback controls, 11-band equalizer, library management and lyric system are designed and implemented independently; commercial use is not permitted without the author's authorization.
about_disclaimer: This software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. The author accepts no liability for any direct or indirect loss arising from its use.
about_third: Built on several open-source third-party libraries (React Native and its ecosystem, audio playback modules); their license texts ship with the installer.

You can turn off the option to fallback to the app's built-in file selector if you are unable to import files after enabling the option.
